data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'bahah' meaning 'glory' or 'exalted'. In Islamic tradition, it is a name given to boys and is considered to be a noble and honorable name. The name Baha carries the meaning “Glory, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baha usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
